overview_description.description: Rocket Money (formerly Truebill) is a leading personal finance app with the mission to empower people to live their best financial lives. The company offers its members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving their members a leg up on their financial journey. Members can manage subscriptions, lower their bills, build budgets and automatically set aside money to reach their savings goals.

about_short_description.short_description: Rocket Money is the easiest way to find subscriptions, manage bills, and even cancel recurring charges with a single click.

product.name: Subscription Management
product.description: A service that identifies and tracks recurring subscriptions and bills linked to a user's financial accounts.

product.name: Bill Negotiation
product.description: A service that identifies bills eligible for reduction and negotiates lower rates on behalf of the user.

product.name: Financial Goals (Autopilot Savings)
product.description: An automated savings feature that analyzes user accounts to save money at optimal times, helping users reach their financial goals while avoiding overdraft fees.

product.name: Spending Insights
product.description: A tool that provides a detailed breakdown of users' spending patterns across linked accounts to help understand and manage expenses.

product.name: Budgeting
product.description: A feature that allows users to create and monitor budgets by category to track spending and stay on financial goals.

product.name: Credit Score Monitoring
product.description: A service that provides access to users' credit reports and scores, with alerts for significant changes affecting credit health.
